title: Blended Internship Program
subtitle: Champions — Reimagining Third Spaces

summary: This certificate of achievement from Dentsu recognizes my team winning the Blended Internship Program, an international exchange hosted at Breda University of Applied Sciences in the Netherlands, themed Reimagining Third Spaces.
context:
The challenge was to use data-driven development to rethink third spaces — the places beyond home and work or school where community actually happens. Digging into the data, our team landed on a real tension: children are getting smartphones at ever younger ages, and screen time is steadily displacing the face-to-face play and interaction those spaces exist for.

Rather than fighting the phone, we flipped it into the solution. We designed QuestSpace, a mobile app concept that uses the device already in kids' hands to pull them outside — turning parks, squares, and other third spaces into playable quests that reward real-world exploration and getting together in person. We took it from data analysis to problem framing, through ideation, and into a working prototype.
representation: Our group finished as champions of the program. For me, this achievement captures the full arc I want my work to follow: start from evidence, frame a problem that genuinely matters, and turn it into a customer-centered product — delivered with an international team under a fast-paced format.

title: Renaissance Appreciation
subtitle: COVID-19 Support Recognition
summary: This certificate was awarded for sustained contribution during the COVID-19 period at Renaissance Downtown Hotel, Dubai.
context: I was part of a small, selected team entrusted with helping manage operations during an unconventional period. As conditions evolved rapidly, we frequently had to step beyond our formal job scope, and adapt workflows in real time to maintain service standards and keep the business running effectively.

title: Cross Training Certificate
subtitle: Front Office Ambassador Track
summary: This certificate confirms completion of training in the Front Office Department as a Front Office Ambassador.
context: As the first point of contact for guests, the training centered on maintaining brand standards, anticipating guest needs, and delivering a consistently high level of customer satisfaction. It was also a masterclass in communication, as the role required daily interaction with high-profile guests while handling service with discretion, confidence, and professionalism.
representation: This certificate reflects continuous learning and upward growth. I initially joined Renaissance in the F&B department, and after completing this training I was promoted into the Front Office team. For me, it represents trust earned through performance, and the ability to grow into more demanding responsibilities.
